title: Herbal Kenyan Energy Toast
description: A refreshing and energizing toast infused with the flavors of Kenya, perfect for a morning pick-me-up.
instructions: Steep the energizing herbal tea in hot water for 3-5 minutes.
Toast the whole wheat bread until lightly browned.
Mash the fresh mint leaves to release their oils.
Mix the honey and cinnamon in a small bowl.
Assemble the toast by spreading the honey-cinnamon mixture on the toasted bread, then topping with the mint leaves and a teaspoon of steeped tea.
